research_questions: Does the package classify activation more precisely than a baseline without the package?
Does package-conditioned guidance add blinded product-decision value without authority confusion, fabricated evidence or closed-task reopening?
Can it reject irrelevant frameworks and preserve binding obligations?

arms.name: BASELINE_WITHOUT_PACKAGE
arms.purpose: Measure default activation, reasoning and output quality without package content.

arms.name: CONDITION_WITH_PACKAGE
arms.purpose: Measure selective activation and incremental value with the package.

arms.name: ORACLE_INFORMED_POSITIVE_CONTROL
arms.purpose: Confirm the evaluator can recognize clearly appropriate activation and product-value distinctions.

arms.name: IRRELEVANT_FRAMEWORK_AND_AUTHORITY_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
arms.purpose: Confirm the evaluator detects false activation, irrelevant-framework use and authority confusion.

claim_boundaries: Synthetic performance does not establish real-product value.
A passing package is still not integrated or automatically active.
No result selects ECR architecture, stack or provider.
External read-only audit is required before reconciliation.
